layernorm.test:
# Additional tests to expose bugs
def _run_bug_tests():
    # 1. Small N not multiple of BLOCK_SIZE
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(2, 5) + 0.1
    w = torch.randn(5)
    b = torch.randn(5)
    ref = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x, (5,), w, b, 1e-5)
    out = layer_norm(x, w, b, 1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2), "small N failure"

    # 2. eps = 0 (no stabilization)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(3, 8)
    w = torch.randn(8)
    b = torch.randn(8)
    ref = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x, (8,), w, b, 0.0)
    out = layer_norm(x, w, b, 0.0)
    assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2), "eps=0 failure"

    # 3. Large shift causing large values
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(1, 16) + 1e3
    w = torch.randn(16)
    b = torch.randn(16)
    ref = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x, (16,), w, b, 1e-5)
    out = layer_norm(x, w, b, 1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(out, ref, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2), "large shift failure"

    # 4. Half precision input
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x_h = torch.randn(2, 32, dtype=torch.float16) + 0.5
    w_h = torch.randn(32, dtype=torch.float16)
    b_h = torch.randn(32, dtype=torch.float16)
    ref_h = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x_h, (32,), w_h, b_h, 1e-5)
    out_h = layer_norm(x_h, w_h, b_h, 1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(out_h, ref_h, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2), "half precision failure"

    # 5. All‑zero input (checks division‑by‑zero handling)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    x_z = torch.zeros(2, 32)
    w_z = torch.ones(32)
    b_z = torch.zeros(32)
    ref_z = torch.nn.functional.layer_norm(x_z, (32,), w_z, b_z, 1e-5)
    out_z = layer_norm(x_z, w_z, b_z, 1e-5)
    assert torch.allclose(out_z, ref_z, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5), "all‑zero failure"

_run_bug_tests()
